WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record(convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb)
  AS x(case_id text, schema_version text, context_id text, title text, category_key text, status text, next_deadline_at timestamptz,
       opened_at timestamptz, closed_at timestamptz, identifiers jsonb, body jsonb)
), vorher AS (
  SELECT c.case_id, c.case_number, (c.body = r.body || jsonb_build_object('case_number', c.case_number)) AS gleich
  FROM jarvis_privat."case" c JOIN r ON c.case_id = r.case_id
), nummer AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vorher) THEN (SELECT case_number FROM vorher)
              ELSE jarvis_privat.next_case_number(extract(year FROM (SELECT opened_at FROM r) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int) END AS case_number
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat."case" (case_id, schema_version, context_id, case_number, title, category_key, status, next_deadline_at, opened_at, closed_at, body)
  SELECT r.case_id, r.schema_version, r.context_id, n.case_number, r.title, r.category_key, r.status, r.next_deadline_at, r.opened_at, r.closed_at,
         r.body || jsonb_build_object('case_number', n.case_number)
  FROM r, nummer n
  ON CONFLICT (case_id) DO UPDATE SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title, category_key = EXCLUDED.category_key, status = EXCLUDED.status, next_deadline_at = EXCLUDED.next_deadline_at,
    closed_at = EXCLUDED.closed_at, body = EXCLUDED.body, updated_at = now()
  WHERE jarvis_privat."case".body IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.body
  RETURNING case_id
), kennung AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.case_identifier (case_id, identifier_type, value_normalized, issuer, first_seen_document_id)
  SELECT r.case_id, k->>'identifier_type', k->>'value_normalized', k->>'issuer', k->>'first_seen_document_id'
  FROM r, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(r.identifiers, '[]'::jsonb)) AS k
  ON CONFLICT (identifier_type, value_normalized) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING case_identifier_id
)
SELECT r.case_id AS resolved_id,
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vorher) THEN 'created'
            WHEN (SELECT gleich FROM vorher) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM kennung) = 0 THEN 'unchanged'
            ELSE 'updated' END AS write_outcome
FROM r

SELECT (c.case_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, $2::text AS write_outcome, c.case_id, c.case_number, c.context_id, c.title, c.category_key, c.status,
       to_char(c.next_deadline_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS next_deadline_at,
       to_char(c.opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS opened_at,
       to_char(c.closed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS closed_at,
       coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identifier_type', k.identifier_type, 'value_normalized', k.value_normalized)
                                  ORDER BY k.identifier_type COLLATE "C", k.value_normalized COLLATE "C")
                 FROM jarvis_privat.case_identifier k WHERE k.case_id = c.case_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS identifiers
FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_privat."case" c ON c.case_id = $1
